messages:
jen: getting a flurry of reports: black frames + captions stuck at 00:00 for some viewers. audio OK for hosts. @video-team please triage. :rotating_light:
mark: seeing encoder cpu spike and frame enc backlog in the dashboard. pulling a quick tail now.
mark: ```enc-21 WARN backlog_ms=450
enc-21 ERROR frame_drop=7 reconnecting```
priya: can we put up a static slide and continue audio Q&A? also request local capture just in case.
gabe: prepping backup ingest and asking stage ops for SD card handoff. will coordinate DNS flip if needed.
ops-bot: Incident created IN-2026-237: all-hands video degraded -> paging video-team.
emma: starting local OBS capture as precaution: `obs-cli --profile=allhands_emergency --startrecording` file: /tmp/allhands_1897654321.mkv
zach: NDI shows intermittent GOP gaps; last-keyframe age spiking to 3s. suspect stage switcher <-> encoder network.
leo: leadership prefers audio continue. I'll prepare a slide: "Video degraded — continuing audio Q&A" and post to participants.
jen: putting the slide up now and notifying attendees. thanks.
mark: spinning up backup ingest and will do DNS swap in 10s.
mark: doing DNS swap... swapped. monitoring reconnect.
mark: backup ingest connected, encoder bitrate normalizing. can folks confirm video returning? :eyes: 
emma: hosted player shows video back, local recording growing. starting checksum when complete.
priya: hosted archive missed ~45s around the glitch. Gabe, can you fetch cam1/cam2 SDs so we can stitch?
gabe: asked stage ops to hand over cam SDs; ETA ~4-6m. copying to s3://allhands-raw/1897654321/ (upload in progress).
alina: captions pipeline backlog noted; restarting captions worker to drain. caption delay currently ~22s but decreasing.
zach: minor note: overlay with "last keyframe: Xs" would have saved a bunch of time triaging. logged in notes.
ops-bot: Action created: TICKET-ALLHANDS-131 "Enable auto local-capture for all-hands" assigned to ops.
ops-bot: Action created: TICKET-ALLHANDS-132 "Add encoder heartbeat overlay" assigned to video-team.
leo: once SDs uploaded I'll stitch emma's local + cam files and produce a short clip for product. ETA ~18m.
mark: full logs uploaded: s3://infra-logs/allhands/1897654321/encoder.log (video-team perms).
priya: postmortem checklist item: - auto local-capture, - heartbeat overlay, - upgrade encoder firmware on enc-21.
jen: thank you all for quick switch and keeping Q&A live. i'll compile follow-ups and share the stitched clip when ready. closing thread after upload. :white_check_mark: 
emma: if anyone needs the raw local before stitch, ping me and I'll drop it in the shared bucket.
gabe: cam SDs copied to s3; checksum OK.
leo: stitched clip uploaded to https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1897654321/stitched-clip.mp4 with a 00:40 highlight of the outage and timestamps.
jen: received. filing actions and closing thread. thanks team.
mark: scheduling encoder firmware patch for enc-21 during next maintenance window.
alina: captions lag resolved, re-syncing live transcript archive.
jen: closing thread now. good recovery everyone.
